cross_dataset_selection_note: Each transfer direction uses the backbone selected using only the source dataset's validation Macro-F1.

cric.selection_rule: Highest observed validation Macro-F1 on the source dataset; target-dataset validation and test results are not used for backbone selection.

riva.selection_rule: Highest observed validation Macro-F1 on the source dataset; target-dataset validation and test results are not used for backbone selection.
